caption: The drawing depicts a single octagonal object positioned near the center of the image, with a small dark ribbon or strap attached to its left side. The octagonal object has alternating color patterns; the two vertical central panels are a reddish-brown color with horizontal line details, and the three narrower vertical panels on each side are a pale cream color decorated with a repeating floral pattern in green and white. The ribbon or strap is a dark bluish-green color and appears slightly folded. The background is a uniform, light beige or off-white color, and there are no other objects or patterns present in the composition.
title: Pin Cushion
